# Rotor: "Ugrinsky Style wind Turbine", by GeoJolt

Source: MakerWorld, <https://makerworld.com/de/models/861294-ugrinsky-style-wind-turbine>.
Licence, from the file's metadata: **Standard Digital File License**, so the 3MF is not in git (ADR-003).

To rebuild on a new machine: log in to MakerWorld, download the 3MF, and put it here as
`Ugrinsky_Wind_Turbine.3mf`. `src/vawt/io/import_turbine.py` pins its SHA-256.

The file gives: 1 bottom, 1 middle (print 3), 1 top, 1 bracket (the original project uses 2), and needs an
M8 bolt and 608 bearings. Slicer profile: 0.12 mm, 2 walls, 15 % infill, in PLA. Print this project's in ASA.
